content: याज्य {%a.%} .²1 To be sacrificed. .²2 Sacrificial. .²3 One for whom a sacrifice is performed. .²4 One who is allowed by Śāstras to sacrifice. .{@-ज्यः@} .²1 A sacrificer, the institutor of a sacrifice; याज्यात्मजमथो दृष्ट्वा <ls>Mb. 13. 93. 27</ls>. .²2 The performer of a sacrifice for another. .{@-ज्यम्@} The presents or fee received for officiating at a sacrifice. .{@-ज्या@} a sacrificial text or verse, Ṛk (recited at the offering of an oblation); याज्यया यजनकर्मिणोऽत्यजन् <ls>Śi. 14. 20</ls>.
